chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Big eaters in Cab's band: Jonah Jones, Chu Berry and the Boston Cotton Club
summary: Danny and Milt recall Jonah Jones finding the chef, the open dressing room in Boston, and Chu Berry eating a whole turkey from his mother.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Looking for the chef?
The chef. You know, when we'd be on those long trips.

Yeah. Yeah, well, they had a thing... They was big eaters, them boys. Jonah Jones, too. He'd always find out the chef. Anywhere there was a cook, there was Jonah Jones. He would get with the waiters, and the waiters were always bringing him a half-a-steak, and you'd see Jonah in the corner with a plate, and he'd be eating, and these chicks... You know, you're out there, and you're missing the good food. But Jonah had a waiter in the Sherman Hotel who used to bring Jonah, oh, half a steak maybe three times a night. His boy would come up with a plate ...(?)...
Hey, Danny, what's that place we used to play in Boston?
That was the Cotton Club.
The Cotton Club!
Remember the gangsters and racketeers tried to open up a Cotton Club there, and it didn't go?
Barker - V-54
Yeah. And we could play that place...
Yeah, and play there right where the guys was cookin'.
Right. We used to go out there in...
Right where the dressing room was. It was an open dressing room. They didn't have a dressing room.
That's right.
It was about eight in the night, and they was cookin'. And Chu Berry got to them chefs, and them people was fryin' one for the people and one for Chu.
He'd go home with a chicken every night.
Remember the night he ate that whole turkey?
Yeah, I remember that.
His mother sent him a turkey, he didn't give nobody none.
He sure did.
She sent him a turkey through the mail some kind of way, and he had jars full of the gravy and everything. And he got that food, and he cooked it...
He sure did.
And he locked the door, and he went in -- and he ate so much til he took sick, and had damn bad indigestion, and they had to take him to the hospital and pump him out. That was something.
